verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, OpenAI-compatible tool specifications, and a drop-in replacement for OpenAI, so an agent can switch to it by pointing the client at api.fireworks.ai. A documented Create Chat Completion endpoint backs this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in switching, and documentation of compatibility edges (unsupported parameters, provider-specific model IDs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Fireworks provides an OpenAI compatible endpoint.
Fireworks provides fast, cost-effective access to leading open-source text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Migrate from OpenAI: Drop-in replacement for inference and training — same API, same SFT data format
You can build agents that access APIs, retrieve real-time data, or perform actions—all through OpenAI-compatible tool specifications.
You point your client at `api.fireworks.ai`, send tokens, and pay only for what you use
